Definition: from G5097; vindication, i.e. (by implication) a penalty:--punishment.
BiblicalUsage: Hebrews uses this word once, and it is the heaviest sentence in the letter. Of how much sorer punishment, the writer asks, shall he be thought worthy who has trodden under foot the Son of God and counted the blood of the covenant an unholy thing?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the warning is meant to stop me short: to know the Son and then trample Him is worse than any punishment under Moses.
